evidence: Modifies `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `ci/test/*` scripts to replace FreeBSD cross-compilation with a native VM CI job.
rationale: Adds native FreeBSD testing to CI to catch platform-specific regressions before merge instead of relying on noisy nightly runs. Reviewers note that BSD issues frequently surface in nightlies and having native CI testing in the repository provides substantial durable value.
